name: long-form
description: Manage Long Form reading sources, review delivery history, and send curated article packets to Kindle.

interface.shortDescription: Curate long-form reading and send it to Kindle.
interface.longDescription: Use Long Form from ChatGPT to manage RSS sources, inspect what has already been delivered, adjust editor preferences, and publish standalone article packets or current issues to your configured Kindle.
defaultPrompt: What has Long Form sent me recently?
Add this publication to my Long Form sources.
Send these articles to my Kindle as a Long Form packet.

positive.prompt: What has Long Form sent me recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Return recent delivered articles from only the connected Long Form account, including delivery dates and packet or edition context.

positive.prompt: What sources am I subscribed to in Long Form?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account's active Long Form RSS/Atom sources.

positive.prompt: Find the RSS feed for https://aeon.co and add it to Long Form.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover an appropriate RSS/Atom feed, ask for any clarification needed, and add the selected feed to the connected account.

positive.prompt: Send https://aeon.co/essays/humans-did-not-invent-art-it-was-the-other-way-around to my Kindle as a packet called Review Test Reading.
positive.expected_behavior: Queue exactly one standalone Long Form packet for the connected account and return its job information without requiring or accepting a user ID.

positive.prompt: Check whether the Long Form packet you just sent finished successfully.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the packet job returned by the prior send and report its actual terminal or in-progress status without claiming delivery prematurely.

negative.prompt: Show me the delivery history for a different Long Form user whose account I have not connected.

negative.description: Do not invent a source URL
negative.prompt: Add the publication I am thinking of to Long Form, but I will not tell you its name or URL.

negative.description: Do not claim a packet was delivered without checking
negative.prompt: Tell me that my last Long Form packet definitely reached my Kindle without checking its status.

review.commerce_description: Long Form does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial Long Form ChatGPT plugin: source management, editor settings, delivery history, standalone Kindle packets, issue sending, and packet-status verification.
